name: Streaming Dao And Tokenized Governance The Problem Of Decentralized Decision Makin Bb04F5297E
text: DAO and tokenized governance treats decentralization as a measurement problem and proposes criteria based on minimum independent decision centers and the relationship among protocol, users, and developers. That framework qualifies Kaal's hierarchy-centered account of decentralization by identifying additional dimensions that a metric may need to capture. The proposition is conceptual and normative, not an empirical validation of either metric.
